fields.name: map
fields.description: Javascript code to run as the map operation which associates a value with a key and emits the key and value pair.

fields.name: reduce
fields.description: Javascript code to run as the map operation which reduces all the values associated with a particular key to a single value.

fields.name: out
fields.description: Out Options sub-object or string representing a collection.

fields.name: query
fields.description: Query object in match language to use as a filter applied before the map step.

fields.name: sort
fields.description: Sort specification to apply before the map step.

fields.name: collation
fields.description: collation specification which takes effect for 'query' and 'sort'.

fields.name: limit
fields.description: Document count limit to apply before the map step.

fields.name: finalize
fields.description: Javascript code to run after the reduce operation.

fields.name: scope
fields.description: Javascript global variable mapping for map, reduce and finalize.

fields.name: verbose
fields.description: Specifies whether to include the timing information in the result information.

fields.name: bypassDocumentValidation
fields.description: Causes the out portion of the operation to ignore the output collection's document validation.

fields.name: jsMode
fields.description: Deprecated non-functional option which is ignored.

fields.name: shardIdentity

fields.name: max
fields.description: Max key of the chunk

fields.name: maxChunkSizeBytes
fields.description: Max chunk size of the collection expressed in bytes

fields.name: bounds
fields.description: The exact boundaries for a single chunk.

name: cloneCatalogData
description: The internal cloneCatalogData command on a shard

fields.name: from
fields.description: The connection string of the database to clone from.

fields.name: commitTimestamp
fields.description: Timestamp at which to commit the transaction. Required for prepared transactions and illegal for non-prepared ones.

fields.name: recoveryToken
fields.description: A mongos that doesn't know about this transaction can attempt to make progress on commit by processing using the info in the recoveryToken.

fields.name: participants
fields.description: An array of shard participants that must be included in the commit.

fields.name: query
fields.description: A query that selects which documents to count in the collection or view.

fields.name: limit
fields.description: The maximum number of matching documents to count.

fields.name: skip
fields.description: The number of matching documents to skip before counting subsequent results.

fields.name: hint
fields.description: The index name to use or the index specification document.

fields.name: collation
fields.description: The collation to use in the count command.

fields.name: fields
fields.description: A BSONObj added by the shell. Left in for backwards compatibility.

fields.name: readConcern
fields.description: A BSONObj read concern.

fields.name: $queryOptions
fields.description: Unwrapped read preference.

fields.name: capped
fields.description: Specify true to create a capped collection. If you specify true, you must also set a maximum size in the 'size' field.

fields.name: autoIndexId
fields.description: Specify false to disable the automatic creation of an index on the _id field.

fields.name: idIndex
fields.description: Specify the default _id index specification.

fields.name: size
fields.description: Specify a maximum size in bytes for the capped collection.

fields.name: max
fields.description: The maximum number of documents allowed in the capped collection. The 'size' limit takes precedence over this limit.

fields.name: storageEngine
fields.description: Specify a configuration to the storage engine on a per-collection basis when creating a collection.

fields.name: validator
fields.description: Specify validation rules or expressions for the collection.

fields.name: validationLevel
fields.description: Determines how strictly to apply the validation rules to existing documents during an update. Can be one of following values: 'off', 'strict' or 'moderate'.

fields.name: validationAction
fields.description: Determines whether to error on invalid documents or just warn about the violations but allow invalid documents to be inserted. Can be either 'warn' or 'error'.

fields.name: indexOptionDefaults
fields.description: Allows users to specify a default configuration for indexes when creating a collection.

fields.name: viewOn
fields.description: The name of the source collection or view from which to create the view.

fields.name: pipeline
fields.description: An array that consists of the aggregation pipeline. Creates the view by applying the specified pipeline to the 'viewOn' collection or view.

fields.name: collation
fields.description: Specifies the default collation for the collection or the view.

fields.name: writeConcern
fields.description: A document that expresses the write concern for the operation.

fields.name: recordPreImages
fields.description: Sets whether updates/deletes should store the pre-image of the document in the oplog

fields.name: temp
fields.description: DEPRECATED

fields.name: flags
fields.description: DEPRECATED

fields.name: deletes
fields.description: An array of one or more delete statements to perform.

fields.name: key
fields.description: The field path for which to return distinct values.

fields.name: query
fields.description: Optional query that filters the documents from which to retrieve the distinct values.

fields.name: collation
fields.description: Optional collation for the command.

name: dropConnections

fields.name: hostAndPort
fields.description: List of host and ports

name: fsyncUnlock

name: getDatabaseVersion
description: An internal command to get a shard server's cached database version

fields.name: inMemory

name: httpClientRequest

fields.description: Document location to fetch

fields.name: timeoutSecs

fields.name: documents

fields.description: An object representing the options on the from collection with the same format as the options from the listCollections command.

fields.name: indexes
fields.description: An object with form {indexName: {spec}, indexName: {spec}, ...}

fields.name: nameOnly
fields.description: Return just the database name without metadata

fields.name: authorizedDatabases
fields.description: Only return those databases for which the user is authorized

fields.name: filter
fields.description: Filter description to limit results

name: logMessage
description: Log a message on the server

fields.name: extra
fields.description: Structured data to include with log message

fields.name: severity
fields.description: Severity of log message

fields.name: debugLevel
fields.description: When using 'debug' severity, what level of debug is to be used?

fields.name: slowms
fields.description: The threshold, in milliseconds, at which ops are profiled and logged.

fields.name: sampleRate
fields.description: The fraction of eligible ops, in the range [0,1), to be logged/profiled.

fields.name: filter
fields.description: A query predicate that determines which ops are logged/profiled. This is an alternative to slowms and sampleRate. The special value 'unset' removes the filter.

name: refineCollectionShardKey

fields.name: key
fields.description: The index specification document to use as the new shard key.

fields.name: to
fields.description: The new namespace for the collection being renamed.

fields.name: dropTarget
fields.description: If true, mongod will drop the target of renameCollection prior to renaming the collection.

fields.name: stayTemp

fields.name: size

fields.name: minRetentionHours

name: setDefaultRWConcern

fields.name: defaultReadConcern

fields.name: defaultWriteConcern

fields.name: indexNames

fields.name: commitQuorum

fields.name: filter

fields.name: filename

fields.name: bufferSize

fields.name: maxFileSize

fields.name: updates
